name: HTN02b: Known Hypertension cases
description:
Number of active ART clients documented as known Hypertension cases during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have a known-hypertensive status indicating controlled, uncontrolled, receiving treatment, or not receiving treatment. Patients newly diagnosed during the same reporting quarter are excluded.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.htn_status IN (
      'Known Hypertensive, not controlled and on lifestyle modification and Medication',
      'Known Hypertensive, not controlled and on lifestyle modification',
      'Known Hypertensive and Controlled and on lifestyle modification',
      'Known Hypertensive but not on Treatment',
      'Known Hypertensive and Controlled and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card n
      WHERE n.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND n.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
        AND n.htn_status IN (
            'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification',
            'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
